defect: reset release for the core domain is generated by a synchronizer on a reference clock
rationale: command_q runs on clk_core, but its asynchronous reset release is produced by stages clocked with unrelated clk_ref.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the synchronized edge path to its reset-release pipeline and one core-domain consumer.

mutation.description: Used clk_ref for the two reset-release stages that asynchronously release command_q on clk_core.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: clk_core reset released by a synchroniser clocked by clk_ref, so release is async to clk_core.
